description: Tornyol develops 40-gram autonomous micro-drones equipped with ultrasonic phased-array sonar and digital signal processing to detect and eliminate mosquitoes.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Expert in digital signal processing and electronics, leading hardware development and signal processing.
Specializes in drone control systems and algorithms, overseeing flight control and interception systems.

funding_summary: Raised $500,000 in September 2025 and $1.03 million on November 7, 2025 in seed rounds.
inflection_why_now: The successful demonstration of the first air-to-air insect kill by an autonomous micro-drone marks a significant advancement in mosquito control technology.
devils_advocate_risks: Achieving reliable and consistent mosquito detection and elimination in diverse environments.
Ensuring scalability and affordability for widespread adoption in various regions.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Their focus on innovative technologies aligns with Tornyol's development of autonomous micro-drones for mosquito control.
Their interest in health-related innovations complements Tornyol's mission to combat mosquito-borne diseases.
